musicBrainz.label: MusicBrainz
musicBrainz.help: Off until you turn it on. Sends a track's artist and title to musicbrainz.org.

acoustId.label: AcoustID
acoustId.help: Off until you turn it on. Sends an audio fingerprint of a track and its length to acoustid.org.
acoustId.unavailable: Not available in this version yet.

discogs.label: Discogs
discogs.help: Off until you turn it on. Sends a track's artist and title to discogs.com, with your own Discogs token.
discogs.getLabel: Get a token at (copy the address):
discogs.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the address and copy it.

outcome.switchOff: Discogs is switched off, so the token was not checked or saved.
outcome.storeUnavailable: This computer has no password store to keep a token in.
outcome.rejected: Discogs did not accept that token. Nothing was saved.
outcome.couldNotCheck: Couldn't reach Discogs to check the token. Nothing was saved. Try again.
outcome.storeFailed: Discogs accepted the token, but this computer's password store refused it. Nothing was saved.
outcome.failed: Couldn't save the token. Try again.

coverArt.label: Cover Art
coverArt.help: Off until you turn it on. Asks coverartarchive.org for a release's front cover.
